VR.title: Xreal's new $299 AR glasses bring the big-screen experience to more people
VR.summary: Xreal launches its budget a01+ AR glasses in the U.S. for $299, featuring a 147-inch virtual screen and 120Hz refresh rate.

VR.title: Ghosts of Tabor: Legacy Returns The Shooter To Its 2024 Era Later This Month
VR.summary: Combat Waffle Studios is set to release Ghosts of Tabor: Legacy, restoring the 2024 version of the game for Meta Quest and PC VR.

VR.title: Apple Publishes Detailed Technical Specifications for Third-party Vision Pro Motion Controllers
VR.summary: Apple has published technical specifications for third-party motion controllers compatible with its Vision Pro headset, enhancing its accessory ecosystem.

VR.title: John Carmack Reminds Microsoft He'll Guarantee $1 Million To Bring Team Beef’s Ports To VR
VR.summary: John Carmack has reiterated his $1 million offer to Microsoft to support VR ports of classic id Software games.

VR.title: Meta Reaffirms "Multiple Next-Generation Headsets", Hints At Connect Announcement
VR.summary: Meta's CTO confirmed ongoing development of multiple next-generation headsets, hinting at an upcoming announcement at Connect.

VR.title: ‘Tomb Raider’ VR Reportedly Cancelled According to Leaked Images & Video
VR.summary: Leaked images reveal that Vertigo Games was developing a Tomb Raider VR game before it was reportedly canceled.

AI.title: Apple sues OpenAI for allegedly stealing hardware secrets
AI.summary: Apple has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging the theft of trade secrets to advance its AI hardware initiatives.

AI.title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-5.6 after government greenlight — and announces ‘ChatGPT Work’
AI.summary: OpenAI has launched GPT-5.6 after receiving government approval, marking a significant update in its AI model offerings.

AI.title: Google will now tell you if an ad was made with AI
AI.summary: Google introduces a new feature that labels ads created or edited with AI in its ad platforms, enhancing transparency.

AI.title: Would you host part of an AI data center in your home?
AI.summary: Sunrun is launching a pilot program to place AI data center compute units in customers' homes, incentivizing participation.

AI.title: Meta turns off the Instagram feature that let users make AI deepfakes of public accounts
AI.summary: Meta is disabling a controversial Instagram feature that allowed users to create AI deepfakes from public accounts following backlash.

AI.title: Fidji Simo steps down from leading OpenAI’s AGI work due to illness
AI.summary: Fidji Simo is stepping down from her role as OpenAI's AGI chief due to health issues, transitioning to a part-time advisory position.

NFL.title: Niners part owner agrees to purchase Seahawks
NFL.summary: Vinod Khosla's group has agreed to purchase the Seahawks for a record $9.612 billion, requiring him to divest from the 49ers.

NFL.title: Commanders to retire No. 44 of HOF RB Riggins
NFL.summary: The Washington Commanders will retire Hall of Famer John Riggins' No. 44 jersey, honoring his legacy over 40 years after his iconic Super Bowl run.

NFL.title: Sources: CB Douglas to sign with Commanders
NFL.summary: Free agent cornerback Rasul Douglas is set to sign a one-year deal with the Washington Commanders worth up to $3.8 million.

NFL.title: Clutch Vinatieri to enter Colts' Ring of Honor
NFL.summary: Kicker Adam Vinatieri will enter the Colts' Ring of Honor during a ceremony on October 18, shortly before his Hall of Fame induction.

NFL.title: Study: NFLers die from dementia at higher rate
NFL.summary: A new study reveals NFL players are four times more likely to die from neurodegenerative diseases compared to the general population.

NFL.title: Vinod Khosla-led group agrees to buy the Seahawks for a reported $9.612 billion
NFL.summary: Vinod Khosla's wife, Neeru, will become the controlling owner of the Seahawks as part of the record-breaking sale.
